# Flowytics - AI-Powered CFO for Manufacturers

## About Flowytics

Flowytics is an AI-powered financial intelligence platform designed specifically for manufacturers. Our Agentic CFO helps manufacturing businesses master their cash flow through intelligent visualization, scenario simulation, and automated supplier communications.

## Key Features

### Runway Vision
Real-time cash flow visualization with AI-powered forecasting. See your financial runway at a glance with up to 18+ months of forecasting accuracy. Monitor your cash position and make informed decisions.

### Agentic Actions  
AI-powered automation that drafts and sends supplier communications automatically. Our AI assistant handles payment schedule updates, term negotiations, and routine supplier correspondence on your behalf.

### Instant Import
Drop your CSV files and watch them transform into actionable financial insights. No complex setup required - just import your data and get immediate visibility into your finances.

## Who We Serve

Flowytics is built for:
- Manufacturing companies managing complex supply chains
- CFOs and financial controllers seeking better cash flow visibility
- Operations teams needing to automate supplier communications
- Businesses wanting AI-powered financial forecasting
